en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a medieval gate structure with two round towers and a central archway. The gate is made of brick, with a pointed roof and small windows. The road leading through the archway is cobblestone and features tram or streetcar tracks. There are iron railings on both sides of the road, and some buildings and trees are visible in the background. The top left corner of the card has printed text in French identifying the location.
